sections.title: Bug Fix Update
sections.description: This is a bug fix update. Replay codes have been wiped.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
sections.description: Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause the Stadium UI to disappear at the start of a round (again) Fixed an issue where Emre's gun would swap if you reloaded and cast your ultimate at the same time Fixed an issue where Mercy’s mythic skin caused the damage boost beam to align directly with the center of Bastion’s turret form
